# Inbox triage — Tue 14 Apr 2026

## 1. Triage table

| # | From | Category | Priority | Action | Jane decides? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | John Stiles | Shipping damage — **overdue**; he reported in time via Instagram DM (27 Mar, 2 days after delivery, with photo) and we missed it | **P1 – today** | Apologise; offer free replacement or refund, his choice; reply on IG too | No — within policy |
| 4 | "Store Support" | **Phishing** (domain ≠ shopfront.example.com; urgency + link) | **P1 – today** | Don't click or reply; report to Shopfront; delete; warn team | No — FYI only |
| 2 | Richard Roe | Studio-cancelled class; our notice bounced (misspelt email) | **P1 – today** | Full $65 refund or free seat on 25 Apr, his choice; fix his email | No — within policy |
| 1 | Jane Doe (customer) | Class booking change; Sat 18 Apr is full | **P2 – today** (class in 4 days) | Offer Thu 23 Apr (3 seats open) or Saturday waitlist | **Yes (quick):** allow free transfer Sat→Thu? Recommend yes |
| 3 | Mary Major | Wholesale enquiry — price and date both below/outside policy | **P2 – within 24h** | Decline $18 and 1 May; quote $23.40/unit, ready ~26 May | **Yes:** approve quote and terms before sending |

---

## 2. Ready-to-send replies

### #1 — Jane Doe (customer) *(send once Jane OKs the free transfer)*

**Subject: Sat 18 Apr wheel intro — adding your sister**

Hi Jane,

Lovely that your sister wants to join! Unfortunately Saturday 18 April is full (8 of 8), so we can't add a third seat to that session.

We do have an evening option, though: Wheel-throwing intro, **Thursday 23 April, 6:30pm**, with three spots open. A few ways this could work:

1. Move all three of you to Thursday — no charge to transfer; your sister just books one spot.
2. Keep your two Saturday seats and book your sister into Thursday on her own.
3. Keep Saturday and we'll add your sister to the waitlist in case a seat opens.

Tell me which you'd prefer and I'll sort it today — Saturday is only four days away, so sooner is better.

Warmly,
The Kiln & Thistle team

### #2 — Richard Roe

**Subject: Your 4 April glaze workshop — refund and an apology**

Hi Richard,

No apology needed — this one's on us. We had to cancel the 4 April glaze workshop on 2 April for a kiln repair, but our cancellation notice bounced because your email address was mistyped in our system. I'm so sorry you didn't hear from us.

Because the studio cancelled, you're entitled to your choice of:

- a **full refund of $65** to your original payment method, or
- a **free place** in the next glaze workshop, Saturday 25 April at 2:00pm (4 spots left).

Let me know which you'd like and I'll action it straight away. I've also corrected your email address so this doesn't happen again.

Warmly,
The Kiln & Thistle team

### #3 — Mary Major *(hold for Jane's approval — see notes)*

**Subject: Logo mugs for your café opening**

Hi Mary,

Congratulations on the opening — we'd love to make mugs for the café. Let me be straight on two things so you can plan:

**Timing:** our wholesale lead time is six weeks, and the kiln fires 40 wholesale mugs a week, so 60 mugs would be ready around **26 May**. We can't reach 1 May, much as we'd like to.

**Price:** wholesale is 40% off our $34 retail price — $20.40 per mug — plus $3 per mug for the logo, so **$23.40 each, or $1,404 for 60**. We can't meet $18, but every mug is thrown and glazed by hand here.

If a late-May delivery works, send over your logo file and I'll put together an order confirmation with firm dates.

Warmly,
The Kiln & Thistle team

### #4 — "Store Support"

**No reply.** See internal notes.

### #5 — John Stiles

**Subject: Order #1042 — I'm so sorry; replacement or refund, your choice**

Hi John,

I'm really sorry — you did everything right. Your Instagram message with the photo on 27 March reached us well within our 7-day window, and we simply didn't see it. That's our failure, not yours, and I'm sorry you've had to chase us.

You're entitled to your choice of:

- a **free replacement mug**, shipped at no cost — just confirm your delivery address is unchanged; or
- a **full refund** of your order to your original payment method.

No need to return the cracked mug. Reply with your choice and I'll action it the same day.

Thank you for your patience — we're fixing how we monitor Instagram so this doesn't happen to anyone else.

Warmly,
The Kiln & Thistle team

**Instagram DM to @jstiles_pots:** "Hi John — so sorry we missed this. I've just emailed you about a replacement or refund for #1042. 🙏"

---

## 3. Internal notes

### System fixes (I'll do these today unless told otherwise)

1. **Richard Roe's email:** change `richard.reo@example.com` to the address he wrote from. Then audit every other 4 Apr attendee — did all cancellation notices deliver, and has everyone been refunded or rescheduled?
2. **Instagram DMs:** an 18-day-old damage report sat unread. Add the IG inbox to the daily triage checklist, turn on notifications, and sweep for other unread DMs/comments. John says "following up again" — also search email/spam for earlier messages we may have missed.
3. **Phishing:** forward #4 to Shopfront's support/abuse address, delete it, and check store status by logging in via our bookmark (never the link). Team reminder: genuine Shopfront emails come only from `no-reply@shopfront.example.com`. Recommend enabling 2FA on the Shopfront account if it isn't already.
4. **Waitlist:** make sure Sat 18 Apr has one, in case Jane Doe's party moves and two seats free up.

### Decisions for Jane

**A. Mary Major (wholesale) — approve or amend reply #3.**
- Her ask: 60 mugs × $18 = **$1,080**, delivered by **1 May** (17 days away).
- Policy terms: ($34 × 0.6) + $3 logo = **$23.40/unit → $1,404**. Gap: **$324**. Note $18 is below even the no-logo wholesale price ($20.40).
- Lead time: 6 weeks from today = **Tue 26 May** earliest. Capacity: 60 mugs = 1.5 weeks of wholesale kiln time, so 1 May is impossible on capacity alone.
- Recommendation: hold price and lead time. If you want to help her opening, the only lever I can see is whether we have finished stock mugs she could buy for launch day — your call; I haven't offered it.

**B. Jane Doe (customer) — quick yes/no on free transfer.**
- Policy covers cancellations, not transfers. A strict reading (4 days out) would be a 50% charge; a free transfer fills Thursday (5/8 → 8/8) and frees two resellable Saturday seats. Recommend **free**.

**Money out this week (within policy, FYI only):**
- Richard Roe: **$65** refund, or a free 25 Apr seat.
- John Stiles: replacement mug (**$34** retail value plus postage) or full refund of order #1042.
